name: Sahir Keshan
source_profile:
Sahir Keshan (LN) — Master Weaponsmith

Sahir is a Qasari craftsman who operates the Sixth Bolt, having settled in Redvale after recognizing the growing demand for repeating hand crossbows. A meticulous artisan, he learned the traditional Qasari mechanisms from his family and takes considerable pride in the precision of his work.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 102 (source excerpt; may be partial)
